# Beebo Entertainment
> A free, local-first Windows media server with Android apps and a browser player. Made by a family man, not a data company. Beebo plays media the owner provides; it includes no movies or shows. For adults 18+.

## Current platform and service labels
Use only Available, Beta, In development and Planned as status labels. Availability is not a claim that every feature or device has been tested.
- Available: Windows desktop server; Android phone app (sideload); Beebo Auto (sideload); browser player.
- Beta: Android TV; Link a TV; Linux (no download offered); Docker/NAS (no download offered); Jellyfin-compatible API; Beebo Relay.
- In development: Google Play; Fire TV; macOS; native iPhone, iPad and Apple TV apps; Roku; Samsung/LG TV; Xbox; BeeboVPN; online games.
- Planned: hosting; rewards; ads.
- PlayStation support was dropped.
- Beebo Relay, BeeboVPN, paid plans, hosting and rewards are not purchasable. There is no promise that any relay will remain free forever.

## How it works and testing limits
The owner runs Beebo on their own Windows computer. The source media stays there. The computer must be on and running Beebo for live streaming from it. Away viewing tries a direct, end-to-end encrypted connection; connection signalling and sign-in use small text records. A relay can carry encrypted video when needed.
Campsite Mode and Trip Journal are Beta. Prepared solo activities can work offline; sharing with nearby guests uses a local Wi-Fi connection or hotspot. Prepare downloads before leaving internet access. Do not infer group, device or real-world acceptance from an illustration, a source review or an automated test.
Testing evidence remains in https://www.beeboentertainment.com/testing-status.json and the existing site-data files. Read the named build, date, counts and limitations for each feature. Older evidence does not establish the behavior of a newer download.

## Privacy in one line
video is end-to-end encrypted and the relay cannot see it; connection records (including IP addresses) are kept 7 days for abuse handling; nothing is sold.
